mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, leading to increased wage pressures and higher corporate costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% MoM signals a strengthening demand in the housing sector, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where HOUST MoM > 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% MoM signals a weakening supply chain, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO MoM < -1%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is below 2% YoY, it signals a restrictive monetary policy combined with weak economic growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4% and GDPC1 YoY < 2%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 MoM signals strong job growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS MoM > 200,000.

mechanism_narrative: When real estate loans (RSAFS) increase by more than 5% YoY and GDP (GDPC1) growth is above 3% YoY, it signals strong demand coupled with robust economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where RSAFS YoY > 5% and GDPC1 YoY > 3%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances following a 3-month decline in FEDFUNDS.
